entities.summary: Yulia Anatoliivna Svyrydenko is a Ukrainian politician who has served as the 19th prime minister of Ukraine since 17 July 2025. Before that, she was the first deputy prime minister and Minister of Economic Development and Trade from 2021, until she replaced Denys Shmyhal as prime minister as part of a government reshuffle proposed by President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
